title: The Derived Non-Abelian Exponential Sequence and Calibrated Current Sieve: Resolving the Higher Codimension Obstruction via Non-Abelian Gerbes, Chiral Intermediate Jacobian Taring, and Parabolic Heat Flows
description: Standalone Zenodo Paper T27 presenting an unconditional pathway for the Hodge Conjecture via derived non-abelian matrix exponentials, chiral intermediate Jacobian Schur complement taring, and calibrated parabolic current heat flows. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
